required_fixes: AX sampling non-compliance: spec requires >=15 tasks stratified 2-per-family across >=10 families (=> >=20 tasks for 10x2) but producer computed AX_consistency on 7 families with 2 tasks each (15 trees total, 1 orphan task 672 without pair) per result.json:metrics.ax_consistency.families_checked=7 and measurements.json:ax_consistency.family_details length 7. spec requires >= >= spec10 threshold (result.json:validity_notes and provenance.json:execution_notes.sampling_note acknowledge 8 families vs spec >=10). Fix: resolve spec/task-count inconsistency, ensure round-robin yields >=10 families x2, disclose sampling code frozen before extraction and recompute threshold gate as MEASUREMENT_INVALID until coverage met.

AX element-pattern mapping bug: research/intel/exp_35741921602_measure.py pattern_map ordering causes all 'Add*' families to match first prefix 'Add {{product}} to my wish list' (expecting button 'Add to Wish List') via prefix.split('{{')[0]='Add' in tpl[:30] early-exit, so Add the product on the current page..., Add the product with lowest..., Add a {{product}}..., Add {{product}}... all incorrectly expect 'Add to Wish List' button. Homepage has no 'Add to Wish List' button (only 'My Wish List' link + 'Add to Cart' / 'Search' buttons; verified in axtree_web_sample_live.json role extraction) so 5/7 families fail artifactually. Correct fix: longest-prefix match, distinct prefix without fallthrough, validate mapping against known product-page vs homepage AX, and freeze corrected table before recomputation.

AX representation non-discriminating: all 15 live trees have 1426 nodes and URL http://localhost:7770/?task={id} but per raw tree inspection normalized hashes remain 15 distinct yet all contain same homepage button set (combobox Search true, Add to Cart true, wishlist button false on all 15). Navigation to ?task= param lands on identical homepage state, not task-specific start states (product/cart/account pages). Hence AX_consistency tests whether homepage contains template-required element (e.g., 'Save' for address change, 'Submit' for contact forms) not whether same intent_template maps to same element pattern across parameterized variants. Fix: verify task url field vs homepage, navigate to task-specific start_url/category/product_id or disclose that AX_consistency as defined measures homepage coverage only and cannot falsify within-family identifiability; rename metric to avoid overclaim.

Mind2Web spec-compliance: producer correctly reports MEASUREMENT_INVALID per spec Gate 0 (HF osunlp/Mind2Web single train split 73 websites/3 domains/1009 tasks vs spec 137/31 and 4 official splits). Diagnostic overlap 0.8139 vs shuffle null mean 0.9979 excess -0.1840 computed with website-label permutation on 50/50 website split is correctly labeled diagnostic in measurements.json:mind2web_diagnostic.note and not used for decision. Fix: pin HF dataset revision hash (currently 'unknown' in provenance.json:datasets.mind2web.revision), record per-split census on pinned revision exposing official train/test_task/test_website/test_domain before computing TF-IDF->k-means train-only and 1000 shuffle perms; until then keep Mind2Web axis BLOCKED/MEASUREMENT_INVALID and do not report k/2,2k sensitivity as if spec-compliant.

Missing uncertainty and artifact gaps: report.md artifacts table hashes (6dec7bb2..., e5e7b8e1..., a1b2c3d4...) do not match result.json artifacts shas (f4b6e236..., c2482cbb..., 56242294...); no bootstrap CI for AX_consistency; no k/2 and 2k sensitivity for Mind2Web (correctly noted as unresolved but should be explicitly BLOCKED); shuffle_null.json and measurements.json are distinct derived artifacts but share overlapping content without provenance link. Fix: regenerate artifact table from result.json hashes, add bootstrap CI for AX_consistency (requires >=10 families), and log TF-IDF vocab hash / centroids hash per spec measurement_validity.

validity_findings.finding: AX_consistency measurement INVALID despite Gate 0 PASS
validity_findings.detail: Producer reports AX_consistency=0.2857 (2/7) <0.6 => FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING. Recomputed value matches producer arithmetic (2/7=0.2857) but operational definition invalid: (a) coverage 7 < spec 10 families, so per spec falsifier clause 'AX_consistency is null/unmeasurable (fewer than 10 families with 2-per-family)' should classify as null/MEASUREMENT_INVALID, not clean falsification; (b) pattern_map bug causes false negatives for all Add* families (see required_fixes); (c) all 15 trees extracted via CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree at 1280x720 with 1426 nodes each share identical homepage role set (combobox Search present, Add to Cart present, Add to Wish List absent) after normalizing ?task= URL, so consistency reflects homepage element presence not cross-task variant pattern stability. Homepage PC1 passes via same tree. Effect could not express within-family parameterized transfer. Therefore FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING verdict is not justified as valid scientific negative; correct state is MEASUREMENT_INVALID/INCONCLUSIVE for element-pattern level pending corrected mapping and task-specific navigation.
